title: Prosecutors Request Four-Year Prison Sentence for Former Minister Rachida Dati in Corruption Trial
detail: French prosecutors have requested a four-year prison sentence against former justice minister Rachida Dati, accused of entering into a corruption pact with former Renault-Nissan CEO Carlos Ghosn. Dati allegedly received payment for lobbying services as part of the alleged corrupt arrangement.

title: Prosecutors Request Heavy Prison Sentence Against PM Bayrou at MoDem Appeal Trial
detail: At the MoDem appeal trial, French prosecutors requested a heavy prison sentence against Prime Minister François Bayrou. The case concerns the MoDem party's alleged use of European Parliament assistants for non-parliamentary work.

title: Pope Leo XIV Walks Back Statements on 'Systemic' Church Sexual Violence After France Visit
detail: On the return flight from his visit to France, Pope Leo XIV walked back earlier statements attributed to him by abuse victims regarding the 'systemic' character of sexual violence in the Catholic Church, nuancing the remarks and clarifying his position.
